newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 15.36 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 15.36 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills dropped by 0.45 percentage points to 15.36 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 15.81 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Wednesday.
Applications for 32.0 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at an average price of 96.75 kwacha percent.
The average rate for six-month bills went up to 16.44 percent from 15.80 percent two weeks ago.
Applications for 26.1 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 23.1 million kwacha. The average price was 92.1 kwacha percent.
For nine-month bills, the average rate dropped to 15.71 from 15.79 percent two weeks ago.
Applications for 28.5 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 21.8 million kwacha at the average price of 91.0 kwacha percent.
